title: The trail names each commit from inside it
desiredOutcome: a scoped commit carries the journal row that names it, so a phase can end with a clean tree, and every reader of those rows resolves the commit they name

tasks.title: A scoped commit carries the journal row that names it
tasks.description: Every scoped commit writes the journal row naming it AFTER the commit, so the row is never inside it and no phase ends with a clean tree (reported by a user; visible on this repo at every phase end). Structural fix: write the row BEFORE the commit, keyed by a nonce the commit message carries as a trailer, stage it into the same commit, and resolve the SHA from the trailer (git log --grep) wherever a reader needs it - which also survives a rebase. Survey every reader of these rows (audit-journal, doctor, verify-invariants, the panel, journal-writes' record keys) and keep each one right; the hash chain must still verify.

outcome.technical: commit_with_rows writes nonce-keyed rows before staging, an Audit-Row trailer names them, readers resolve via git log --grep, refusals append a withdrawal row.
outcome.descriptive: Every audit commit now contains the journal row that names it, so a phase can finish with a clean tree.

tasks.title: audit-journal merge resolves the evidence ledger too, and a same-second tie over disjoint targets is ordered rather than refused
tasks.description: The evidence ledger is hash-chained like the journal and, before per-worktree writer keys, was appended on two branches under one name; audit-journal merge reads only the journal directory, so every such conflict was resolved by hand (interleave by timestamp, re-chain with the journal's row_hash). Give the evidence ledger the same merge verb the journal has - one implementation for both directories, the same refusals (a same-second tie that disagrees, a torn tail, a rewritten shared prefix), the same re-chain and a marker the evidence schema accepts (or a documented reason there is none) - and let a same-second tie whose rows touch disjoint targets be ordered deterministically instead of refused, with the order it chose written in the marker.
